messages.text: I've hear the 40T miner will void the warranty if ran at the advertised rate of 50 TH/s. Is this true?

Yes, that's right, Larry. The 40T is rated at 40 TH/s, not 50. The listing shows three modes: Eco is 30 TH/s at about 450 W, Standard is 40 TH/s at about 650 W, and Turbo is 50 TH/s at about 850 W. Turbo counts as an overclock and voids the warranty.

You've said you'll stay stock, so Standard gets you the full rated 40 TH/s with the warranty intact. Eco is the quietest at around 50 dB, so it may be the better pick near the horses.
I stated I didn't plan or running at 50 TH/s, but till now it was always an option. If 50 voids the warranty THEN WHY DO YOU LIST THAT AS A POSSIBLE OPTION???

That's a fair question, Larry. Turbo is built into the unit's firmware, so we list it rather than hide it. The listing labels it as an overclock that voids the warranty, so nobody turns it on without knowing. The rated, covered speed is 40 TH/s.

I'm sorry it wasn't that clear before. I can't see how the page looked when you ordered. If it showed 50 TH/s without that warning back then, tell me and I'll ask the team how that affects your two orders.

ASK. Granted, I did say I didn't plan on running at 50, but that was before I rewired the back building where they were both going to be located in. Now I can safely run them at 50, but now you say it voids the warranty.
Four days before you ship to me and I find this out on Discord.
Having found major issues with the Bitfortun BS-4 after receiving it, and now hearing this... have I made another faulty purchase?
To me this sounds borderline deceitful.
Handed to the team · Warranty position on Turbo for existing orders needs a person; customer is upset

I'm sorry you heard about this on Discord four days before shipping. You rewired that building so you could run Turbo, so I understand why this feels like a bait and switch.

I've asked the team how Turbo affects the warranty on your two 40Ts, and whether the page showed that warning when you ordered. Please stay in the chat. One of them will come in here, and if you step away, their answer comes to your email.

What's going wrong with the BS-4? I'll make sure they have that too.

I'M NOT WAITING IN CHAT. YOU'VE ASKED ME TO WAIT IN CHAT SEVERAL TIMES AND AFTER WAITING HOURS I WON'T WAIT AGAIN. 
THIS IS BS!

You're right, and I'm sorry. You shouldn't have to sit here again, so please don't. The team has your question about Turbo and the warranty on both 40Ts, and their answer will come to (email hidden)

When you have a minute, reply with what's wrong with the BS-4. Whatever you send is added to the same case, so you won't have to explain it twice.
